title: Hearty Dense Moroccan Buckwheat Mrouzia
description: A rich and savory Moroccan dish featuring buckwheat, slow cooked in a iron teppan, wrapped in a flaky crust, perfect for a cold winter night, this recipe is ayurvedic tamasic friendly and full of umami flavors.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the toasted buckwheat, chopped onion, sliced mushrooms, olive oil, mrouzia spices, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the buckwheat mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
Place the mrouzia in the preheated iron teppan and bake for 45 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 325 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes.
Remove the mrouzia from the teppan and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
